<!DOCTYPE html>

<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

    <title>Contact | Green Optima</title>

    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>

    <link
        href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap"
        rel="stylesheet"
    >

    <style>

        /* =========================================================
           GREEN OPTIMA — DARK PREMIUM THEME
        ========================================================= */

        :root {

            --green: #4F8F32;
            --green-light: #6FAF45;
            --green-bright: #82B95A;
            --green-dark: #18351D;

            --black: #030504;
            --black-2: #050806;
            --black-3: #080D09;
            --black-4: #0B110C;

            --cream: #EEEDE5;
            --cream-dark: #E4E2D8;

            --white: #F7F8F4;
            --white-soft: #EDEFEA;

            --text: #101510;
            --muted: #737A73;

            --dark-text: rgba(247, 248, 244, .68);

            --border-dark: rgba(111, 175, 69, .16);
            --border-light: rgba(20, 45, 24, .12);

            --radius: 24px;

        }


        /* =========================================================
           RESET
        ========================================================= */

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        body {

            margin: 0;

            font-family:
                "DM Sans",
                sans-serif;

            background:
                var(--cream);

            color:
                var(--text);

            overflow-x: hidden;

        }

        button,
        input,
        textarea,
        select {
            font: inherit;
        }

        button {
            cursor: pointer;
        }


        /* =========================================================
           CUSTOM CURSOR
        ========================================================= */

        .cursor {

            position: fixed;

            width: 7px;
            height: 7px;

            background:
                var(--green-light);

            border-radius: 50%;

            pointer-events: none;

            z-index: 9999;

            transform:
                translate(-50%, -50%);

            box-shadow:
                0 0 10px
                rgba(111,175,69,.45);

        }


        .cursor-ring {

            position: fixed;

            width: 30px;
            height: 30px;

            border:
                1px solid
                rgba(111,175,69,.45);

            border-radius: 50%;

            pointer-events: none;

            z-index: 9998;

            transform:
                translate(-50%, -50%);

        }


        body.cursor-active .cursor {

            width: 14px;
            height: 14px;

        }


        body.cursor-active .cursor-ring {

            width: 48px;
            height: 48px;

        }


        /* =========================================================
           HERO
        ========================================================= */

        .hero {

            position: relative;

            height: 60vh;

            min-height: 500px;

            max-height: 700px;

            overflow: hidden;

            display: flex;

            align-items: center;

            color:
                var(--white);

            background:

                radial-gradient(
                    circle at 73% 45%,
                    rgba(79,143,50,.12),
                    transparent 32%
                ),

                radial-gradient(
                    circle at 22% 100%,
                    rgba(28,59,32,.12),
                    transparent 40%
                ),

                linear-gradient(
                    135deg,
                    #030504 0%,
                    #050806 48%,
                    #0A100B 100%
                );

        }


        /* =========================================================
           HERO GRID
        ========================================================= */

        .hero-grid {

            position: absolute;

            inset: 0;

            background-image:

                linear-gradient(
                    rgba(79,143,50,.032) 1px,
                    transparent 1px
                ),

                linear-gradient(
                    90deg,
                    rgba(79,143,50,.032) 1px,
                    transparent 1px
                );

            background-size:
                70px 70px;

            transform:
                perspective(700px)
                rotateX(58deg)
                scale(1.5);

            transform-origin:
                center bottom;

            opacity: .7;

            pointer-events: none;

        }


        /* =========================================================
           HERO GLOW
        ========================================================= */

        .hero-glow {

            position: absolute;

            width: 650px;
            height: 650px;

            right: 0;

            top: 50%;

            transform:
                translateY(-50%);

            background:

                radial-gradient(
                    circle,
                    rgba(79,143,50,.10),
                    rgba(79,143,50,.035) 35%,
                    transparent 70%
                );

            filter:
                blur(18px);

            pointer-events: none;

        }


        /* =========================================================
           PARTICLES
        ========================================================= */

        .particles {

            position: absolute;

            inset: 0;

            pointer-events: none;

        }


        .particle {

            position: absolute;

            width: 3px;
            height: 3px;

            border-radius: 50%;

            background:
                var(--green-light);

            box-shadow:

                0 0 9px
                rgba(111,175,69,.6),

                0 0 22px
                rgba(79,143,50,.3);

            animation:

                floatParticle
                var(--duration)
                ease-in-out
                infinite
                alternate;

        }


        .particle:nth-child(1) {
            left: 11%;
            top: 25%;
            --duration: 4s;
        }

        .particle:nth-child(2) {
            left: 28%;
            top: 70%;
            --duration: 5s;
        }

        .particle:nth-child(3) {
            left: 52%;
            top: 17%;
            --duration: 4.5s;
        }

        .particle:nth-child(4) {
            left: 71%;
            top: 27%;
            --duration: 5.5s;
        }

        .particle:nth-child(5) {
            left: 89%;
            top: 57%;
            --duration: 4s;
        }

        .particle:nth-child(6) {
            left: 64%;
            top: 78%;
            --duration: 6s;
        }

        .particle:nth-child(7) {
            left: 43%;
            top: 35%;
            --duration: 4.7s;
        }

        .particle:nth-child(8) {
            left: 82%;
            top: 78%;
            --duration: 5.2s;
        }


        @keyframes floatParticle {

            from {

                transform:
                    translate3d(0,0,0)
                    scale(.7);

                opacity: .25;

            }

            to {

                transform:
                    translate3d(0,-24px,0)
                    scale(1.5);

                opacity: .9;

            }

        }


        /* =========================================================
           HERO INNER
        ========================================================= */

        .hero-inner {

            position: relative;

            z-index: 10;

            width: 90%;

            max-width: 1450px;

            margin: auto;

            display: grid;

            grid-template-columns:
                56% 44%;

            align-items: center;

            padding-top: 20px;

        }


        /* =========================================================
           HERO COPY
        ========================================================= */

        .hero-copy {

            position: relative;

            z-index: 20;

        }


        .eyebrow {

            display: flex;

            align-items: center;

            gap: 11px;

            color:
                var(--green-light);

            font-size: 11px;

            font-weight: 600;

            letter-spacing:
                .19em;

            text-transform:
                uppercase;

            margin-bottom: 21px;

            opacity: 0;

            animation:
                revealUp
                .8s
                .15s
                forwards;

        }


        .eyebrow-line {

            width: 31px;

            height: 1px;

            background:
                var(--green-light);

        }


        /* =========================================================
           HERO TITLE
        ========================================================= */

        .hero-title {

            font-family:
                "Space Grotesk",
                sans-serif;

            font-size:
                clamp(52px, 6.1vw, 94px);

            line-height:
                .88;

            letter-spacing:
                -.065em;

            font-weight:
                600;

            max-width:
                780px;

            opacity: 0;

            animation:
                revealUp
                .9s
                .3s
                forwards;

        }


        .hero-title .white {

            color:
                var(--white);

        }


        .hero-title .green {

            color:
                var(--green-light);

        }


        /* =========================================================
           HERO DESCRIPTION
        ========================================================= */

        .hero-description {

            max-width:
                530px;

            margin-top:
                25px;

            color:
                rgba(247,248,244,.58);

            font-size:
                15px;

            line-height:
                1.65;

            opacity: 0;

            animation:
                revealUp
                .8s
                .5s
                forwards;

        }


        @keyframes revealUp {

            from {

                opacity: 0;

                transform:
                    translateY(24px);

            }

            to {

                opacity: 1;

                transform:
                    translateY(0);

            }

        }


        /* =========================================================
           3D VISUAL AREA
        ========================================================= */

        .visual-area {

            height:
                400px;

            position:
                relative;

            perspective:
                1000px;

            display:
                flex;

            align-items:
                center;

            justify-content:
                center;

            animation:
                visualEnter
                1.2s
                .2s
                both;

        }


        @keyframes visualEnter {

            from {

                opacity: 0;

                transform:
                    scale(.82)
                    translateX(35px);

            }

            to {

                opacity: 1;

                transform:
                    scale(1)
                    translateX(0);

            }

        }


        /* =========================================================
           3D SYSTEM
        ========================================================= */

        .system {

            width:
                365px;

            height:
                365px;

            position:
                relative;

            transform-style:
                preserve-3d;

            transform:
                rotateX(57deg)
                rotateZ(-28deg);

            animation:
                systemFloat
                8s
                ease-in-out
                infinite;

        }


        @keyframes systemFloat {

            0%,
            100% {

                transform:
                    rotateX(57deg)
                    rotateZ(-28deg)
                    translateY(0);

            }

            50% {

                transform:
                    rotateX(57deg)
                    rotateZ(-28deg)
                    translateY(-17px);

            }

        }


        /* =========================================================
           BUILDING
        ========================================================= */

        .building {

            position:
                absolute;

            width:
                145px;

            height:
                205px;

            left:
                110px;

            top:
                80px;

            border:
                1px solid
                rgba(111,175,69,.42);

            background:

                linear-gradient(
                    135deg,
                    rgba(255,255,255,.025),
                    rgba(79,143,50,.035)
                );

            box-shadow:

                inset 0 0 45px
                rgba(79,143,50,.04),

                0 0 40px
                rgba(79,143,50,.06);

            transform-style:
                preserve-3d;

            animation:
                buildingPulse
                5s
                ease-in-out
                infinite;

        }


        .building::before {

            content: "";

            position: absolute;

            inset: 18px;

            border:
                1px solid
                rgba(111,175,69,.23);

        }


        .building::after {

            content: "";

            position: absolute;

            inset: 36px;

            border:
                1px solid
                rgba(111,175,69,.14);

        }


        @keyframes buildingPulse {

            0%,
            100% {

                box-shadow:

                    inset 0 0 45px
                    rgba(79,143,50,.025),

                    0 0 30px
                    rgba(79,143,50,.035);

            }

            50% {

                box-shadow:

                    inset 0 0 55px
                    rgba(79,143,50,.065),

                    0 0 55px
                    rgba(79,143,50,.075);

            }

        }


        /* =========================================================
           BUILDING WINDOWS
        ========================================================= */

        .windows {

            position:
                absolute;

            inset:
                45px 30px;

            display:
                grid;

            grid-template-columns:
                repeat(4,1fr);

            grid-template-rows:
                repeat(5,1fr);

            gap:
                10px;

        }


        .window {

            border:
                1px solid
                rgba(111,175,69,.13);

            background:
                rgba(79,143,50,.025);

            animation:
                windowGlow
                3.2s
                ease-in-out
                infinite
                alternate;

        }


        .window:nth-child(2n) {
            animation-delay: .7s;
        }

        .window:nth-child(3n) {
            animation-delay: 1.2s;
        }


        @keyframes windowGlow {

            from {

                background:
                    rgba(79,143,50,.018);

            }

            to {

                background:
                    rgba(79,143,50,.075);

            }

        }


        /* =========================================================
           ORBITS
        ========================================================= */

        .orbit {

            position:
                absolute;

            border:
                1px solid
                rgba(111,175,69,.24);

            border-radius:
                50%;

            transform-style:
                preserve-3d;

        }


        .orbit.one {

            width:
                410px;

            height:
                145px;

            left:
                -22px;

            top:
                110px;

            animation:
                orbitOne
                10s
                linear
                infinite;

        }


        .orbit.two {

            width:
                300px;

            height:
                110px;

            left:
                35px;

            top:
                128px;

            opacity:
                .65;

            animation:
                orbitTwo
                8s
                linear
                infinite
                reverse;

        }


        .orbit.three {

            width:
                250px;

            height:
                90px;

            left:
                62px;

            top:
                142px;

            opacity:
                .35;

            animation:
                orbitThree
                7s
                linear
                infinite;

        }


        @keyframes orbitOne {

            from {
                transform:
                    rotateZ(0deg);
            }

            to {
                transform:
                    rotateZ(360deg);
            }

        }


        @keyframes orbitTwo {

            from {

                transform:
                    rotateZ(0deg)
                    rotateX(10deg);

            }

            to {

                transform:
                    rotateZ(360deg)
                    rotateX(10deg);

            }

        }


        @keyframes orbitThree {

            from {

                transform:
                    rotateZ(0deg)
                    rotateY(20deg);

            }

            to {

                transform:
                    rotateZ(360deg)
                    rotateY(20deg);

            }

        }


        /* =========================================================
           NODES
        ========================================================= */

        .node {

            position:
                absolute;

            width:
                9px;

            height:
                9px;

            border-radius:
                50%;

            background:
                var(--green-light);

            box-shadow:

                0 0 10px
                rgba(111,175,69,.65),

                0 0 30px
                rgba(79,143,50,.35);

            z-index:
                5;

            animation:
                nodePulse
                2.7s
                ease-in-out
                infinite;

        }


        .node.one {

            left:
                20px;

            top:
                80px;

        }


        .node.two {

            right:
                15px;

            top:
                125px;

            animation-delay:
                .6s;

        }


        .node.three {

            left:
                60px;

            bottom:
                65px;

            animation-delay:
                1s;

        }


        .node.four {

            right:
                65px;

            bottom:
                45px;

            animation-delay:
                1.5s;

        }


        @keyframes nodePulse {

            0%,
            100% {

                transform:
                    scale(.8);

                opacity:
                    .45;

            }

            50% {

                transform:
                    scale(1.6);

                opacity:
                    1;

            }

        }


        /* =========================================================
           CONTACT SECTION
        ========================================================= */

        .contact-section {

            position:
                relative;

            background:
                var(--cream);

            padding:
                105px 5vw 110px;

        }


        .section-container {

            width:
                90%;

            max-width:
                1400px;

            margin:
                auto;

        }


        /* =========================================================
           SECTION HEADER
        ========================================================= */

        .section-header {

            display:
                grid;

            grid-template-columns:
                .3fr 1fr;

            gap:
                50px;

            align-items:
                start;

            margin-bottom:
                65px;

        }


        .section-label {

            color:
                var(--green-dark);

            font-size:
                11px;

            font-weight:
                700;

            letter-spacing:
                .18em;

            text-transform:
                uppercase;

            padding-top:
                10px;

        }


        .section-title {

            font-family:
                "Space Grotesk",
                sans-serif;

            font-size:
                clamp(45px,5vw,76px);

            line-height:
                .94;

            letter-spacing:
                -.055em;

            font-weight:
                600;

        }


        .section-title span {

            color:
                var(--green);

        }


        /* =========================================================
           CONTACT GRID
        ========================================================= */

        .contact-grid {

            display:
                grid;

            grid-template-columns:
                .75fr 1.25fr;

            gap:
                25px;

        }


        /* =========================================================
           INFORMATION CARD
        ========================================================= */

        .info-card {

            position:
                relative;

            overflow:
                hidden;

            min-height:
                520px;

            padding:
                42px;

            border-radius:
                var(--radius);

            color:
                var(--white);

            background:

                linear-gradient(
                    145deg,
                    #0B110D,
                    #050806
                );

            border:
                1px solid
                rgba(111,175,69,.10);

            box-shadow:
                0 25px 70px
                rgba(0,0,0,.16);

            transform-style:
                preserve-3d;

            transition:
                transform .25s ease;

        }


        .info-card::before {

            content: "";

            position:
                absolute;

            width:
                450px;

            height:
                450px;

            right:
                -260px;

            bottom:
                -250px;

            border-radius:
                50%;

            background:

                radial-gradient(
                    circle,
                    rgba(79,143,50,.16),
                    transparent 65%
                );

        }


        .info-card-grid {

            position:
                absolute;

            inset:
                0;

            background-image:

                linear-gradient(
                    rgba(111,175,69,.025) 1px,
                    transparent 1px
                ),

                linear-gradient(
                    90deg,
                    rgba(111,175,69,.025) 1px,
                    transparent 1px
                );

            background-size:
                45px 45px;

            mask-image:
                linear-gradient(
                    to bottom right,
                    black,
                    transparent
                );

        }


        .info-content {

            position:
                relative;

            z-index:
                2;

        }


        .info-title {

            font-family:
                "Space Grotesk",
                sans-serif;

            font-size:
                36px;

            letter-spacing:
                -.04em;

            margin-bottom:
                16px;

        }


        .info-description {

            color:
                rgba(247,248,244,.54);

            line-height:
                1.7;

            font-size:

        /* =========================================================

        ========================================================= */

        const cursor =
            document.querySelector(".cursor");

        const cursorRing =
            document.querySelector(".cursor-ring");


        document.addEventListener(
            "mousemove",
            function(event) {

                cursor.style.left =
                    event.clientX + "px";

                cursor.style.top =
                    event.clientY + "px";


                cursorRing.animate(

                    {
                        left:
                            event.clientX + "px",

                        top:
                            event.clientY + "px"
                    },

                    {
                        duration: 300,

                        fill: "forwards"
                    }

                );

            }
        );


        document
            .querySelectorAll(
                "button, input, textarea, select"
            )
            .forEach(
                function(element) {

                    element.addEventListener(
                        "mouseenter",
                        function() {

                            document.body.classList.add(
                                "cursor-active"
                            );

                        }
                    );


                    element.addEventListener(
                        "mouseleave",
                        function() {

                            document.body.classList.remove(
                                "cursor-active"
                            );

                        }
                    );

                }
            );



        /* =========================================================
           3D MOUSE PARALLAX
        ========================================================= */

        const system =
            document.querySelector(".system");


        document.addEventListener(
            "mousemove",
            function(event) {

                if (
                    window.innerWidth < 900
                ) {
                    return;
                }


                const x =
                    event.clientX /
                    window.innerWidth - .5;


                const y =
                    event.clientY /
                    window.innerHeight - .5;


                system.style.transform =

                    `
                    rotateX(${57 + y * 5}deg)
                    rotateZ(${-28 + x * 7}deg)
                    translateY(${y * -10}px)
                    `;

            }
        );



        /* =========================================================
           CARD TILT
        ========================================================= */

        const cards =
            document.querySelectorAll(
                ".info-card, .form-card"
            );


        cards.forEach(
            function(card) {


                card.addEventListener(
                    "mousemove",
                    function(event) {

                        if (
                            window.innerWidth < 900
                        ) {
                            return;
                        }


                        const rect =
                            card.getBoundingClientRect();


                        const x =
                            event.clientX -
                            rect.left;


                        const y =
                            event.clientY -
                            rect.top;


                        const rotateY =
                            ((x / rect.width) - .5)
                            * 3;


                        const rotateX =
                            ((y / rect.height) - .5)
                            * -3;


                        card.style.transform =

                            `
                            perspective(1200px)
                            rotateX(${rotateX}deg)
                            rotateY(${rotateY}deg)
                            translateY(-2px)
                            `;

                    }
                );


                card.addEventListener(
                    "mouseleave",
                    function() {

                        card.style.transform =
                            "perspective(1200px) rotateX(0) rotateY(0)";

                    }
                );

            }
        );



        /* =========================================================
           SCROLL REVEAL
        ========================================================= */

        const revealElements =
            document.querySelectorAll(
                ".reveal"
            );


        const observer =
            new IntersectionObserver(

                function(entries) {

                    entries.forEach(
                        function(entry) {

                            if (
                                entry.isIntersecting
                            ) {

                                entry.target.classList.add(
                                    "visible"
                                );

                                observer.unobserve(
                                    entry.target
                                );

                            }

                        }
                    );

                },

                {
                    threshold: .12
                }

            );


        revealElements.forEach(
            function(element) {

                observer.observe(element);

            }
        );



        /* =========================================================
           CONTACT FORM
        ========================================================= */

        const form =
            document.getElementById(
                "contactForm"
            );


        const success =
            document.getElementById(
                "successMessage"
            );


        form.addEventListener(
            "submit",
            function(event) {

                event.preventDefault();


                const buttonText =
                    form.querySelector(

                    );


                buttonText.textContent =
                    "SENDING...";


                setTimeout(
                    function() {

                        buttonText.textContent =
                            "ENQUIRY SENT ✓";


                        success.classList.add(
                            "show"
                        );


                        form.reset();


                        setTimeout(
                            function() {

                                success.classList.remove(
                                    "show"

                                buttonText.textContent =

    </section>


</div>



<script>

    /* =========================================================
       VIDEO
    ========================================================== */

    /*
        Paste the direct MP4 URL of the Pixabay Dubai video here.

        Pixabay video:
        https://pixabay.com/videos/city-cityscape-buildings-dubai-264535/

        Example:

        const PIXABAY_VIDEO_URL =
        "https://your-direct-mp4-url.mp4";
    */

    const PIXABAY_VIDEO_URL = "";


    const heroVideo = document.getElementById("heroVideo");
    const heroVideoSource = document.getElementById("heroVideoSource");


    if (PIXABAY_VIDEO_URL.trim() !== "") {

        heroVideoSource.src = PIXABAY_VIDEO_URL;

        heroVideo.load();

        heroVideo.play().catch(() => {});

    }


    /* =========================================================
       SMOOTH ANCHOR SCROLL
    ========================================================== */

    document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(link => {

        link.addEventListener("click", function(event) {

            const targetId = this.getAttribute("href");

            if (!targetId || targetId === "#") {
                return;
            }

            const target = document.querySelector(targetId);

            if (!target) {
                return;
            }

            event.preventDefault();

            target.scrollIntoView({
                behavior: "smooth",
                block: "start"
            });

        });

    });


    /* =========================================================
       SCROLL REVEAL
    ========================================================== */

    const revealElements =
        document.querySelectorAll(".reveal");


    const revealObserver =
        new IntersectionObserver(

            entries => {

                entries.forEach(entry => {

                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {

                        entry.target.classList.add("active");

                        revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);

                    }

                });

            },

            {
                threshold: 0.12
            }

        );


    revealElements.forEach(element => {

        revealObserver.observe(element);

    });


    /* =========================================================
       HERO VIDEO PARALLAX
    ========================================================== */

    window.addEventListener(
        "scroll",
        () => {

            if (!heroVideo) {
                return;
            }

            const scroll =
                window.scrollY;

            if (scroll < window.innerHeight) {

                heroVideo.style.transform =
                    `scale(1.04) translateY(${scroll * 0.08}px)`;

            }

        },
        {
            passive: true
        }
    );


    /* =========================================================
       CUSTOM CURSOR
    ========================================================== */

    const cursor =
        document.createElement("div");

    cursor.className = "cursor";

    const cursorRing =
        document.createElement("div");

    cursorRing.className = "cursor-ring";

    document.body.appendChild(cursor);
    document.body.appendChild(cursorRing);


    let mouseX = 0;
    let mouseY = 0;

    let ringX = 0;
    let ringY = 0;


    document.addEventListener(
        "mousemove",
        event => {

            mouseX = event.clientX;
            mouseY = event.clientY;

            cursor.style.left =
                mouseX + "px";

            cursor.style.top =
                mouseY + "px";

        }
    );


    function animateCursor() {

        ringX +=
            (mouseX - ringX) * 0.15;

        ringY +=
            (mouseY - ringY) * 0.15;

        cursorRing.style.left =
            ringX + "px";

        cursorRing.style.top =
            ringY + "px";

        requestAnimationFrame(
            animateCursor
        );

    }


    animateCursor();


    /* =========================================================
       CURSOR HOVER
    ========================================================== */

    document.querySelectorAll(
        "a, button"
    ).forEach(element => {

        element.addEventListener(
            "mouseenter",
            () => {

                cursor.style.width = "18px";
                cursor.style.height = "18px";

                cursorRing.style.width = "48px";
                cursorRing.style.height = "48px";

            }
        );


        element.addEventListener(
            "mouseleave",
            () => {

                cursor.style.width = "10px";
                cursor.style.height = "10px";

                cursorRing.style.width = "34px";
                cursorRing.style.height = "34px";

            }
        );

    });


    /* =========================================================
       MOBILE CURSOR
    ========================================================== */

    if (
        window.matchMedia(
            "(pointer: coarse)"
        ).matches
    ) {

        cursor.remove();
        cursorRing.remove();

    }

</script>

</body>
</html>

}

.panel-top{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
    align-items:center;

    padding-bottom:22px;

    border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);

    font-size:12px;
}

.live{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:8px;

    color:#75e99d;
    font-weight:700;
    letter-spacing:.08em;
}

.live-dot{
    width:7px;
    height:7px;
    background:#75e99d;
    border-radius:50%;
    box-shadow:0 0 12px #75e99d;

    animation:livePulse 1.5s infinite;
}

@keyframes livePulse{
    0%,100%{opacity:.35}
    50%{opacity:1}
}

.panel-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr .9fr;
    gap:18px;

    margin-top:20px;
}

.panel-card{
    min-height:185px;

    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            145deg,
            rgba(69,197,113,.09),
            rgba(255,255,255,.015)
        );

    padding:24px;
}

.panel-card small{
    color:#7e8982;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:.1em;
    font-size:10px;
}

.panel-card strong{
    display:block;

    font-family:"Space Grotesk",sans-serif;

    font-size:38px;

    margin-top:22px;

    color:#72e99b;
}

.status-bar{
    margin-top:18px;

    height:5px;

    background:#18231c;

    overflow:hidden;
}

.status-fill{
    height:100%;
    width:78%;

    background:#55d985;

    animation:statusFlow 4s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}

@keyframes statusFlow{
    from{width:48%}
    to{width:91%}
}

.panel-chart{
    grid-column:1 / -1;

    height:205px;

    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);

    margin-top:0;

    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;

    background:
        linear-gradient(

const revealElements =
    document.querySelectorAll(".reveal");

const revealObserver =
    new IntersectionObserver(
        (entries)=>{
            entries.forEach(entry=>{

                if(entry.isIntersecting){

                    entry.target.classList.add("active");

                    revealObserver.unobserve(
                        entry.target
                    );
                }

            });
        },
        {
            threshold:.12
        }
    );

revealElements.forEach(el=>{
    revealObserver.observe(el);
});

window.addEventListener("scroll",()=>{

        document.querySelector(".ibms-image");

    if(!section) return;

    const rect =
        section.getBoundingClientRect();

    const offset =
        (window.innerHeight - rect.top) * .025;

    section.style.backgroundPosition =
        `center ${50-offset}%`;

});


/* =========================================================
   INTEGRATION CARD 3D TILT
========================================================= */

document
.querySelectorAll(".integration-card")
.forEach(card=>{

        const rect =
            card.getBoundingClientRect();

        const x =
            e.clientX - rect.left;

        const y =
            e.clientY - rect.top;

        const rotateY =
            ((x / rect.width) - .5) * 5;

        const rotateX =
            ((y / rect.height) - .5) * -5;

        card.style.transform =
            `translateY(-5px)
             rotateX(${rotateX}deg)
             rotateY(${rotateY}deg)`;
    });


    card.addEventListener("mouseleave",()=>{

        card.style.transform =
            "translateY(0) rotateX(0) rotateY(0)";

    });

});

            const observer =
                new IntersectionObserver(
                    function (entries) {

                        entries.forEach(function (entry) {

                            if (entry.isIntersecting) {

                                entry.target.classList.add("show");

                                observer.unobserve(entry.target);

                            }

                        });

                    },
                    {
                        threshold: 0.12,

                        rootMargin:
                            "0px 0px -40px 0px"
                    }
                );


            animatedElements.forEach(
                function (element, index) {


                    /*
                     * Stagger card animations
                     */

                    if (
                        element.closest(".serve-grid") ||
                        element.closest(".mission-grid")
                    ) {

                        element.style.transitionDelay =
                            (index % 4) * 0.12 + "s";

                    }


                    observer.observe(element);

            );

<!DOCTYPE html>

<head>

<style>
/* =========================================================
   GREEN OPTIMA — EVENTS PAGE
========================================================= */

:root{
  --black:#050705;--black-2:#080c09;--black-3:#0c120d;
  --green:#4f8f32;--green-light:#6fae45;--green-soft:#9bc879;--green-dark:#19341d;

  --go-green:#7CCB35;--go-bright:#A7E85B;--go-deep:#183D22;--go-black:#07100A;--go-cream:#F3F0E7;
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
}

/* RESET */
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{background:var(--cream);color:var(--text-dark);font-family:var(--go-font);overflow-x:hidden}
button,input{font:inherit}

/* CURSOR */
.cursor{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:7px;height:7px;background:var(--green-light);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;z-index:9999;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(111,174,69,.5);will-change:transform}
.cursor-ring{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:32px;height:32px;border:1px solid rgba(111,174,69,.45);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;z-index:9998;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);will-change:transform}

/* =========================================================
   HERO
========================================================= */
.hero{
  min-height:clamp(540px,72vh,760px);position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 72% 40%,rgba(79,143,50,.15),transparent 30%),
